text:
You did it!
You killed all the orcs around here.
zh:
你做到了！
你把这一带的兽人全干掉了。

text: I thought I'd be trapped here forever!
zh: 我还以为要一辈子困在这儿了！

text: God must have heard my prayers.
zh: 一定是神明听到了我的祈祷。

text:
By the way...
In case you want to enter the big ass temple to the west, you'll need a key.
zh:
对了……
你要是想进西边那座大得吓人的神殿，得先有把钥匙。

text: I just happened to see a mage put it in one of the #:pillars in front of the temple:#.
zh: 我碰巧看见一个法师把钥匙放进了#:神殿前的石柱:#当中的一根里。

text: Maybe that'll be of use to you.
See ya around and good luck!
